# IRAM Perfume

> Authentic designer and Middle Eastern fragrance decants (3ml, 5ml, 7.5ml, 20ml, 30ml) and full bottles, shipped across India. Free shipping above ₹999.

## Key facts
- Decants filled from original genuine bottles, proof shared on request
- Sizes: 3ml / 5ml / 7.5ml / 20ml / 30ml; full bottles on request
- Order via WhatsApp +91 93555 33509 or email perfumeiram@gmail.com
- Free shipping on orders above ₹999 (delivery 3–7 working days)

## Link addresses
- Homepage: https://itsnotme007.github.io/iram-perfume/
